capacity:worker.title: Orders: scenario sizing
capacity:worker.message: At 3× traffic in “Black Friday”, HPA hits its maximum of 10 at 92% CPU of request (target 70% CPU of request). Up to 4,006 messages waited while replicas started. Raise the maximum to 14. A rerun with this change confirmed it.
capacity:worker.rationale: Played headless with the same engine and seed as playback; a suggestion is offered as a fix only when a rerun with it bears it out.
capacity:worker.shownMessage: At 3× traffic in “Black Friday”, HPA hits its maximum of 10 at 92% of the CPU request (target 70%). Up to 4,006 messages waited while replicas started. Raise the maximum to 14. A rerun with this change confirmed it.
capacity:worker.shownRationale: Played with the same engine and seed as playback. A suggestion is a fix only when a rerun with it bears it out.

single-point:worker.title: Every request goes through one Orders
single-point:worker.message: It runs 1 replica, and every request from Traffic goes through it: if it stops, Traffic gets nothing.
single-point:worker.rationale: Redundancy is what turns one instance's availability into a service's: with two replicas, one can stop (a deploy, a crash, a node drained) while the other answers.
